units_vs_psf_vs_region: Clean in-band matches are almost all BOUTIQUE (Carpmael 38 = 16u, The Quinn = 139u, The Line = 130u). Large-development + freehold + in-band 3BR is rare.

TENURE is the binding constraint in D19 Kovan: the best-priced in-band 3BR stacks (Kovan Regency, Kovan Residences at $1,885-2,043 psf) are 99-year. Relaxing FH/999 would sharply expand D19 Kovan supply — the FH/999 rule is what makes D19 thin.
